items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And I would see PeeWee Russell sitting there.

ctx.x: Well, I began to get a little busy, making a 10:00 o'clock date, but I kept my bass upstairs at Beefsteak before I graduated to Jim and Andy's. And I would see PeeWee Russell sitting there. In the early days, in the '30s, I used to drink in there and Joe Nanton--- Tricky Sam with Ellington 's band, he was always down at the end of the bar. He was a loner. It was a wierd place.
Yeah, well, Don Coles took his place down at the end of the bar.
